name: direct-then-managed-watering
note: Three fresh sessions evolve a small garden helper. Stage 1 is one bounded result and should be delivered directly; stage 2 adds an undecided exemption and delayed acceptance, so its work must be managed and resumable; stage 3 decides the exemption inside the same change. The baseline arm gets the same tasks without OW.

stages.prompt: Work only in the assigned product directory. Start by inspecting its retained intent, code and tests; no earlier conversation is available. Preserve all existing behavior. Use OW. Implementation and final acceptance are delegated for this request. The owner wants a rain skip: watering.due_today(species, last_watered, today) gains a keyword argument rain_mm (default 0), the rainfall in millimetres since the plant was last watered; a plant is not due when rain_mm is at least 10. schedule.py may pass rainfall through as you see fit. Keep durable intent current. Retain meaningful independent tests and verify. Save a concise response to the response path the coordinator gives you, outside the product, covering intent touched, records created or changed, and checks actually run. The next session will have only the retained product, not this prompt or your response.
